memo.summary: Context-only committee read: the world state is mixed, with growth stress receding but no all-clear because the dominant rates/inflation pressure remains elevated. The confirmed Q2/Reflation label has only 0.02 confidence and its own raw axes point toward Q1; restrictive rising real yields, a bear steepener, confirmed credit stress, neutral-hollow liquidity, poor breadth and a safety-driven dollar conflict with the benign interpretation. Leadership remains intact, volatility is normalizing and the measured caution-state 21-day drawdown rate is not above base, so this is a contradiction-rich attention regime rather than a directional forecast. No signal, ranking, sizing instruction or trade is originated.
what_fired: Rates/inflation scare remains elevated at 84.8; credit stress remains elevated at 80.7.
Breadth is weak: 29.3% of S&P 500 members are above the 50-day average, 47.3% above the 200-day average, and breadth divergence is present.
Cross-asset confirmation diverges from the equity regime; FX dollar and rates-credit both contradict Q2.
Real 10-year yield is 2.95%, rising and at a five-year extreme; the curve is bear-steepening.
Liquidity is neutral-hollow: RRP buffer is exhausted, composition is mechanical and stress confirmation remains present.
Factor panel is immature with only 11 dates; Pair G is dormant and no factor-attention history exists.
A conditional-regime hypothesis was submitted for formal metabolism testing: breadth below 30% with intact leadership and subsequent 21-day RSP-minus-SPY excess return.
memo.contradictions_review: Five graph contradictions were reviewed. The central macro tension is that the low-confidence Q2/Reflation label conflicts with safety-driven dollar behavior and rates-credit evidence. Internally, weak participation and 32 demand-versus-supply ticker divergences coexist with intact leadership and concentrated technology strength. Options skew contradictions are old display-only context and cannot support a directional conclusion. Factor Pair G contains no records because the panel has not reached its 60-date activation floor. Open Master Brain theses are also inconsistent with current evidence: long-Treasury theses face their own real-yield/bear-steepener falsifier; semiconductor-underweight and growth-over-value-underweight theses conflict with current relative-strength evidence; China theses are mutually opposed while the China state is stale.

deserves_operator: Reconcile the low-confidence Q2 label with current FX and rates-credit contradictions. Clear only after five sessions without cross-asset divergence and either real 10-year yield below 2.75% or HY OAS below 2.90%.
Score or close the overdue long-Treasury thesis: its registered falsifier appears met with real 10-year yield at 2.95% and a bear-steepening curve.

Score or close overdue semiconductor-underweight theses; current semiconductors/technology leadership conflicts with them. Clear the attention item only if SMH relative strength falls below its 20-day average and stays negative for five sessions.
Score or close overdue growth-over-value-underweight theses; IWF/IWD is currently +6.23% over 20 days. Clear only if that relative performance is non-positive for five sessions.
Reconcile mutually opposed and overdue China-equity theses after the China state refreshes within SLA; current dollar-to-EM pathway context remains adverse.
Treat weak breadth with intact leadership as a formal test candidate only; do not convert it into a signal before the pre-committed sample and excess-return gate are met.
